body:
@knutwannheden You're right that the code in `DevConsoleRuntimeTemplateInfoBuildItem` constructor is not able to find the corresponding `groupId` and `artifactId`. It fails now becuase the issue with "local" extensions was partially fixed in the PR for https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/16699.

We can try to supply the `CurateOutcomeBuildItem` that can be used [here](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/core/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/deployment/util/ArtifactInfoUtil.java#L56-L71) or the `pom.properties` like [here](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/extensions/vertx-http/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/vertx/http/deployment/devmode/console/DevConsoleProcessor.java#L604-L617).
